topic: Carrot's Sulong ship-disabling feat on Whole Cake Island fits the Marine fleet problem at Egghead, but Kizaru is her ceiling
title: Kizaru Vs Carrot: Who Really Wins Egghead?
description:
Carrot's Sulong form took the helms off an entire fleet in chapter 888. The Marine siege of Egghead was a fleet problem too. Here is the theory, the strongest counter-argument, and my verdict on what one mink could really change.

Would Carrot have ended the Egghead war alone, or only half of it? Tell me in the comments.
comment: Could Carrot really handle the Marine fleet, or would Kizaru have ended her in one kick? Pick a side.

lines.text: Carrot could have beaten Kizaru's fleet at Egghead alone, and I think Oda built her to do exactly that.

shot.fallback: white rabbit girl glowing under a full moon

lines.text: Not by beating the admirals. By taking away the one thing a Marine fleet can't fight without.

shot.fallback: rabbit warrior flying over warships

lines.text: How does one mink stop an armada that was sent to flatten a whole island?

shot.fallback: large navy fleet approaching a futuristic island

lines.text: Chapter 888 already showed us the answer, and almost nobody connects it to Egghead.

shot.fallback: rabbit girl circling a fleet of ships

lines.text: Four pieces of evidence, the best counter-argument I can find, and a verdict I'll defend, but it starts with her worst night...

shot.fallback: rabbit girl crackling with lightning

lines.text: Watch what one night does to a whole fleet, and then what it costs her...

shot.fallback: tired rabbit girl carried by a skeleton

lines.text: Everyone remembers Whole Cake Island for Luffy and Katakuri. I remember one small moment on the open sea at night.

shot.search: Thousand Sunny night Big Mom fleet
shot.fallback: pirate ship at night chased by ships

lines.text: Daifuku arrives with a second fleet and surrounds the Thousand Sunny. Big Mom's whole army is closing in.

shot.fallback: fleet of ships surrounding a lion ship

lines.text: Then Carrot looks up at the full moon and tells the crew to leave Daifuku's fleet to her.

shot.fallback: rabbit girl staring at a bright moon

lines.text: She transforms into Sulong, and her whole body changes. Faster, stronger, and crackling with her Electro.

shot.fallback: white furred rabbit warrior transforming

lines.text: She flies at a speed Daifuku's sailors can't follow, and she takes down the ships' helms one by one.

shot.fallback: rabbit warrior tearing off a ship steering wheel

lines.text: Not the sailors. The helms. A ship with no helm is just a very large floating house.

shot.fallback: ship steering wheel torn off

lines.text: Daifuku's own genie swings at her, can't land a single hit, and ends up wrecking several of his ships instead.

shot.fallback: giant genie smashing ships by mistake

lines.text: The fleet falls into chaos, and chapter 889 hands the Sunny a clear path through the gap.

shot.search: Sunny clear path Daifuku fleet chaos
shot.fallback: lion ship sailing through scattered ships

lines.text: That is the picture: one mink, one night, and an entire fleet turned into a traffic jam.

shot.fallback: rabbit warrior above scattered ships

lines.text: Now ask what the Marine armada sailing toward Egghead really is, if not a pile of ships that need helms.

shot.fallback: navy ships sailing toward a bright island

lines.text: Hold that thought, because the Marines had a plan for that island that is a lot bigger than ships...

shot.fallback: stern fleet admiral giving orders

lines.text: Start at Marine Headquarters. Fleet Admiral Sakazuki learns the Straw Hats are on Egghead and assumes Vegapunk recruited them.

shot.fallback: stern admiral reading a report

lines.text: His first order is to tell CP0 to wait for Marine reinforcements and not take on the pirates alone.

shot.fallback: admiral ordering secret agents to wait

lines.text: Then Kizaru, who is already heading to Egghead on a different mission, orders every battleship he can mobilize to set course.

shot.fallback: relaxed admiral pointing at a distant island

lines.text: So the war at Egghead isn't one fight. It's a fleet arriving with an admiral standing in front of it.

shot.fallback: admiral in front of battleships

lines.text: Inside the lab, Stussy warns Sentomaru what's coming: CP0 first, then a Marine fleet to bring the island down.

shot.fallback: woman in a hat warning a large armored man

lines.text: The reason is simple. Vegapunk studies Poneglyphs, and Egghead has weapons that could rival the Marines.

shot.fallback: scientist surrounded by glowing machines

lines.text: Sentomaru hears his fear of a Buster Call confirmed, and he tells the citizens to evacuate.

shot.fallback: armored man ordering civilians to leave

lines.text: Sentomaru says the island is about to suffer the same fate as Ohara, and everyone who knows that name knows how that ends.

shot.fallback: armored man looking grim at a lab

lines.text: A Buster Call isn't a duel. It's ships. A lot of ships, firing from the water at a target that can't move.

shot.fallback: many warships firing at an island

lines.text: That's the part the Straw Hat side has no answer for. Luffy can't be everywhere, and neither can Zoro.

shot.fallback: two pirates standing in a futuristic lab

lines.text: Luffy had already promised Sentomaru he'd take Vegapunk off the island, so the only way out is the sea.

shot.fallback: straw hat boy shaking hands with armored man

lines.text: Which means the war comes down to one question. Can the Sunny get past that fleet?

shot.fallback: lion ship sailing away from a bright island

lines.text: And I think the whole answer to that question is a mink who isn't even in the room...

shot.fallback: rabbit girl waving goodbye on a huge elephant

lines.text: Here's my read of why her kit fits this war better than anyone's on the crew.

shot.fallback: rabbit warrior mid-air with lightning

lines.text: Speed first. Sulong Carrot is quick enough that a genie's fist never touches her in chapter 888.

shot.fallback: blur of a rabbit warrior flying

lines.text: Electro second. She constantly crackles with it, and one touch from her can shock a victim into stillness.

shot.fallback: rabbit girl delivering a bolt of electricity

lines.text: Ships are mostly wood and rope and wheels. A mink who can fly above them and take out the helm is a very bad enemy.

shot.fallback: rabbit warrior hovering above warships

lines.text: Now the part nobody mentions. Egghead's own defenders are the real obstacle, and there Carrot has an edge.

shot.fallback: child-sized cyborg warriors in a lab

lines.text: Sentomaru deploys all fifty Pacifistas Mark III to cover the Straw Hats' escape with Vegapunk.

shot.fallback: fifty robot soldiers marching

lines.text: Meanwhile the Seraphim are the real problem inside the lab. Nami and Zoro both find out their attacks barely register.

shot.fallback: navigator facing a cyborg child

lines.text: But here is what most people forgot. Zoro notices the Seraphim have flames on their backs, and they're weak once those flames go out.

shot.fallback: swordsman pointing at flames on a cyborg back

lines.text: And the whole island runs on fire. Lilith says the island's mechanisms are powered through fire.

shot.search: Lilith explains Egghead powered by fire
shot.fallback: scientist woman pointing at a glowing machine

lines.text: Lilith's bubble gun even has Seastone properties, because the green fluid that gives the Stella units their fruit powers gives them the same weakness.

shot.fallback: scientist woman holding a bubble gun

lines.text: So the Seraphim's weak spot is a flame on their back, and the one crew member who can fly above them is Carrot.

shot.fallback: rabbit warrior flying behind a cyborg

lines.text: That's my theory, not canon. But Sulong Carrot reaching a back no sailor on Wano or Zou could reach is exactly what the story set up.

shot.fallback: rabbit warrior above enemies

lines.text: Two more things in her favour. S-Snake petrifies York and half-petrifies Franky, so Seraphim use fruits that need a clear line.

shot.fallback: cyborg girl turning allies to stone

lines.text: A target that is moving too fast to be aimed at is the one thing those powers can't handle.

shot.fallback: cyborg girl using a stone gaze

lines.text: And the Marines' main arrival is a naval force, which is exactly what she already beat once with one jump.

shot.fallback: rabbit warrior flying through a fleet

lines.text: So on paper she covers both the fleet and the Seraphim. But there is a catch, and it's a big one...

shot.fallback: rabbit girl looking at the moon

lines.text: Sulong needs the full moon. That's the first problem for my own theory, and I won't hide it.

shot.fallback: rabbit girl under a bright full moon

lines.text: Minks transform under a full moon, and in chapter 888 Carrot only does it after seeing the moon in the sky.

shot.fallback: rabbit girl pointing at a full moon

lines.text: I can't tell you what the sky above Egghead looked like on the night the fleet arrived, so I'm not going to pretend.

shot.fallback: futuristic island under a night sky

lines.text: What I can say is that the moon rules the story of her transformation, and Oda picked her fleet fight for a night with a full moon.

shot.fallback: rabbit warrior in a moonlit sky

lines.text: Then comes the second problem: the cost. Right after she wrecks the fleet, she is completely exhausted.

shot.fallback: exhausted rabbit girl collapsing

lines.text: Count what she'd need: a full moon, a clear sky, and enough strength left to leave. The Marines only need one of those to fail.

shot.fallback: rabbit girl looking up at a moonlit sky

lines.text: Brook has to go and carry her back to the Sunny, and that's after fighting only Daifuku's fleet. One fleet.

shot.fallback: skeleton musician carrying a rabbit girl

lines.text: In the anime, Daifuku is about to strike her once she hits her limit, and Brook jumps in to grab her.

shot.fallback: skeleton jumping to rescue a rabbit girl

lines.text: That matters, because Sulong keeps her at full speed only for a short stretch before she needs rest.

shot.fallback: rabbit girl panting and weak

lines.text: So the honest version of my claim isn't that she beats everything. It's that she wins the first hour of the war.

shot.fallback: rabbit warrior over a dark ocean

lines.text: And I think the first hour is when the Straw Hats needed her most.

shot.fallback: pirates fighting robots in a lab

lines.text: Think about how little time they had. CP0 was already inside, the Seraphim had gone out of control, and Vegapunk was missing.

shot.search: Egghead lab chaos Seraphim Vegapunk missing
shot.fallback: scientists running through a damaged lab

lines.text: Think about the order of arrival too: CP0 lands first, the Seraphim turn on everyone, and only then does the fleet reach the horizon.

shot.fallback: agents then robots then ships approaching an island

lines.text: A fleet that arrives and finds its helms gone buys the Sunny time the crew never had on paper.

shot.fallback: lion ship racing away from navy ships

lines.text: Every hour the helms stay gone is another hour the Sunny gets to reach open water.

shot.fallback: lion ship reaching open sea

lines.text: But the real test isn't the ships. It's the one man who could stop her in a single move...

shot.fallback: relaxed admiral glowing with light

lines.text: Now the strongest counter-argument, and I want to be fair about this one. Carrot has lost before.

shot.fallback: rabbit girl facing a tall man with a scarf

lines.text: On Whole Cake Island, Katakuri charges the Sanji Retrieval Team, and Carrot tries to attack him. He subdues her easily.

shot.fallback: tall scarfed man stopping a rabbit girl

lines.text: Earlier he did the same to the speedy mink, and chapter 879 says he kept pace with Luffy's Gear 2 attacks.

shot.fallback: fast tall man outpacing a rubber boy

lines.text: That's a fair point. Her non-Sulong form was no match for a Sweet Commander, never mind a Marine admiral.

shot.fallback: scarfed man holding a rabbit girl

lines.text: Katakuri can even outpace Luffy's Gear 4 Snakeman at times, and that's how fast the top tier really is.

shot.fallback: tall man matching a stretching boy's speed

lines.text: Now put Kizaru in that picture. He ate the Pika Pika no Mi, and he moves, kicks and shoots lasers at the speed of light.

shot.search: Kizaru Pika Pika no Mi light
shot.fallback: relaxed admiral glowing with golden light

lines.text: The wiki says his sense of honor in battle is reserved for opponents he respects, and he shows none of it toward pirates.

shot.fallback: relaxed admiral looking down at a pirate

lines.text: On Egghead, the wiki says Saint Saturn even suggested he simply bypass Sentomaru, so he's right there on the island.

shot.fallback: admiral and an elder standing near a big armored man

lines.text: His kicks are heavy enough to take down buildings, and pirates worth over a hundred million fall to a single blow.

shot.fallback: glowing admiral delivering a flying kick

lines.text: So the honest answer is that Sulong Carrot couldn't stand in front of him for even a few moves.

shot.fallback: glowing admiral facing a rabbit warrior

lines.text: I don't think that kills the theory. I think it tells us exactly what her job is.

shot.fallback: determined rabbit girl under the moon

lines.text: Her job isn't to fight Kizaru. It's to make sure Kizaru has no fleet to command and no ship to board.

shot.fallback: relaxed admiral on a ship deck

lines.text: An admiral without ships is still dangerous, but he can't sink a Buster Call by himself, and he can't be in the water too.

shot.fallback: lone admiral standing on a shore

lines.text: Look at what the Straw Hats did when the fleet showed up in chapter 1070. They were boxed in, and only escaped because the giants came.

shot.search: Straw Hats Egghead escape Marine fleet
shot.fallback: pirate crew fleeing past warships

lines.text: Oda has a habit of keeping one specialist off screen until the story needs one exact tool, and a flier above a fleet is that tool.

shot.fallback: rabbit warrior flying over a fleet

lines.text: And that is the part I find strange. They never needed to beat the admirals. They needed to get out.

shot.fallback: scientists boarding a lion ship

lines.text: Getting out of a harbour is exactly what Sulong Carrot did to Daifuku's fleet the first time.

shot.search: Sunny escape Whole Cake Island fleet
shot.fallback: lion ship sailing through scattered fleet

lines.text: A harbour is exactly where a fleet is weakest, because it has to turn, line up, and fire from fixed positions.

shot.fallback: navy ships lined up in a harbour

lines.text: So here's the next question. If she is that useful, where is she now?

shot.fallback: rabbit girl on a giant elephant

lines.text: Because the word in my title is alone, and I owe you a straight answer on what alone really means...

shot.fallback: rabbit warrior alone on a moonlit sea

lines.text: Let me split the Egghead war into two fronts, because I think people argue about it as one.

shot.fallback: pirates standing in a futuristic lab

lines.text: Front one is inside the lab. CP0, the Seraphim, and whoever opened fire on Shaka.

shot.fallback: three agents inside a futuristic lab

lines.text: That front is Zoro and Brook against Kaku, Luffy and Lucci in their awakened forms, and Stussy knocking out CP0 with a lipstick of Seastone.

shot.fallback: two awakened fighters clashing in a lab

lines.text: Carrot doesn't change that front, and I won't claim she does. Luffy and Zoro are the ones who matter there.

shot.fallback: swordsman facing an awakened giraffe man

lines.text: Front two is outside the island. A fleet that has been ordered to bring the whole place down.

shot.fallback: navy ships surrounding a futuristic island

lines.text: Zoro, Sanji, Franky and Nami are all busy inside the lab, so the sea around Egghead really is empty of Straw Hats.

shot.search: Straw Hats Egghead lab Building A
shot.fallback: pirates fighting inside a futuristic lab

lines.text: That front is the one the crew had no answer for, and the one I think only a flier could solve.

shot.fallback: lion ship on open sea near an island

lines.text: So alone doesn't mean she wins every fight. It means she's the only person who solves the second front by herself.

shot.fallback: lone rabbit warrior over a fleet

lines.text: And here is a second thing most of us forget. She did it once already, with no help, in a worse spot.

shot.fallback: rabbit warrior defending a lion ship

lines.text: On Whole Cake Island, Big Mom herself was on the Sunny's trail. Carrot didn't need Luffy for the fleet.

shot.fallback: giant woman chasing a pirate ship

lines.text: Chapter 889 even shows Big Mom, growing thinner by the minute, boarding the Sunny after the fleet falls apart.

shot.fallback: giant woman climbing onto a pirate ship

lines.text: Now compare that to Egghead, where the Marines aren't chasing the Sunny. They're sitting on top of the exit.

shot.fallback: navy ships blocking a harbour

lines.text: I think this is why Oda keeps her off screen. A mink with this kit makes the Straw Hats' escapes too easy.

shot.fallback: rabbit girl smiling with a pirate crew

lines.text: As far as fans can tell, her last appearance was chapter 1056, when she was named the next duke of Zou.

shot.fallback: rabbit girl receiving a title from two elder minks

lines.text: I can't confirm that count, so treat it as the fan count rather than something I verified myself.

shot.fallback: two elder minks with a young rabbit girl

lines.text: But if it's right, then Carrot has spent the whole Egghead war on Zou, and the story kept her away on purpose.

shot.fallback: rabbit girl standing on a giant elephant

lines.text: Because a Carrot on that deck would have broken the tension. And one escape the crew couldn't take for granted is what Oda needed...

shot.fallback: worried pirate crew on a lion ship

lines.text: Now the part I've been building to. If she's coming back, the Elbaph arc is where I'd bet it happens.

shot.fallback: giant island with pirates arriving

lines.text: The Straw Hats are heading to Elbaph, where Shanks has already stopped the Kid Pirates near the island.

shot.fallback: red haired pirate stopping a ship

lines.text: Shanks slices the Victoria Punk's railgun in half, takes the Road Poneglyph rubbings, and then a giant's attack hits their ship.

shot.fallback: red haired pirate slicing a huge cannon

lines.text: So Elbaph already has a sea full of ships. And that is the exact kind of place where my theory would matter.

shot.fallback: giant island surrounded by ships

lines.text: I'm not predicting a Carrot return. I'm saying that if Oda wants a fleet problem solved, her kit is built for it.

shot.fallback: rabbit warrior above warships

lines.text: That's a theory, so let me give you the strongest version of the other side before I land it.

shot.fallback: relaxed admiral shrugging

lines.text: The other side says Oda wrote the Egghead escape as a loss the crew had to take, so any extra rescuer cheapens it.

shot.fallback: somber pirates on a lion ship

lines.text: I think that's a fair argument. A story can need a crew to be rescued by luck, giants and a scientist's secret.

shot.fallback: giants helping a pirate ship escape

lines.text: But that argument is about writing, not strength. And my video was asking about strength.

shot.fallback: rabbit warrior glowing under moon

lines.text: On strength, my verdict is this. Carrot alone could have beaten the Marine fleet, not the Marine admirals.

shot.fallback: rabbit warrior circling a fleet

lines.text: Give her Sulong and a full moon, and a fleet loses its helms. Chapter 888 is the receipt.

shot.fallback: rabbit warrior tearing off ship wheels

lines.text: And I'd rather give you that split answer than sell you a fantasy where one mink walks through an admiral.

shot.fallback: rabbit warrior facing a glowing admiral

lines.text: Put Kizaru and the speed of light in front of her, and her night is over. Chapter 1092 is the receipt.

shot.fallback: glowing admiral mid-kick

lines.text: So she ends the war only if the war is the fleet. Which, honestly, is how the Marines framed it.

shot.fallback: stern admiral commanding a fleet

lines.text: Here is my final read. Oda gave a mink a moon, a lightning bolt and a flying kick, and that is a Marine fleet's worst nightmare.

shot.fallback: rabbit warrior over moonlit sea

lines.text: Whether she ever gets to use it on a real armada is a question only Oda can answer.

shot.fallback: rabbit warrior with lightning

lines.text: But if you want another story about what one missing person would have changed at the Straw Hats' biggest escape, the Vegapunk backup video is next.

shot.fallback: scientist smiling in a futuristic lab
